subject.title: feat(control-ui): session grouping with drag & drop and channel categorization

question: Should OpenClaw expose a persisted per-session `category` field on `sessions.patch`, session rows, and session-change events as the Control UI custom grouping contract?
rationale: The implementation is plausible, but it creates a new public protocol and stored session metadata surface under a protected maintainer/product label, so code review cannot choose that permanent API contract alone.

options.title: Accept Category After Proof
options.body: Keep the category contract, require exact-head checks and redacted browser proof before merge, and document it as the supported grouping field.

options.title: Redesign Grouping State
options.body: Pause this branch and choose a different storage or protocol shape before exposing custom grouping to web and native clients.

options.title: Keep Custom Groups Browser-Local
options.body: Avoid persisted protocol metadata for now, accepting that custom grouping will not follow sessions across clients.

recommendation.title: Accept Category After Proof
recommendation.body: Keep the category contract, require exact-head checks and redacted browser proof before merge, and document it as the supported grouping field.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest visible owner across the proposed category contract, current session reconcile history, and this PR's implementation.
